readme:
# Tanitjobs Jobs Scraper Scrape job listings from Tanitjobs ([tanitjobs.com](https://tanitjobs.com/)), a leading job board in Tunisia. You get the title, company, location, contract type and posting date of every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full description, requirements, sector, salary, experience, education level, languages, number of positions and company page. Search by keyword, or list the latest jobs, and narrow the result to a location. ## What you get - One row per job, with the posting date as an ISO date and the raw date text next to it. - Optional job page details: exact posting time, valid-through date, full description and requirements as HTML and plain text (in French, as published), sector, salary range when the employer states one, contract types, experience, education level, languages, number of positions, company page and website, and keyword tags. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it or a featured job shows on several pages. - A run with no input returns 5 jobs for the keyword comptable. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/tanitjobs-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `tanitjobs-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "comptable" (accountant roles in Tunis). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "comptable" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as comptable, commercial or développeur. Each keyword is its own search. Empty means the latest jobs. | | `location` | Only jobs whose location text mentions one of these places, for example Tunis, Sfax, Sousse or Télétravail. Case and accents do not matter. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | ## Sample output ```json { "id": "2015538", "title": "Commercial Mutuelle Santé (H/F) | Ariana", "company": "IKI Assurances Groupe Filiasur", "company_id": "690700", "company_url": "https://www.tanitjobs.com/company/690700/iki-assurances-groupe-filiasur/", "company_logo": "https://www.tanitjobs.com/files/pictures/2024/05/02/logo_IKI_2022_grofd_transp.png", "company_website": "https://iki-assurances.fr/", "company_verified": true, "location": "Ariana, Ariana, Tunisie", "city": "Ariana", "region": "Ariana", "postal_code": "2035", "country": "Tunisie", "contract_type": "CDI", "contract_types": [ "CDI", "SIVP" ], "employment_types": [ "FULL_TIME", "INTERN" ], "sector": "Assurances, Centres d'appels", "salary_text": "Entre 1000 DT et 1500 DT", "salary_min": 1000, "salary_max": 1500, "salary_currency": "TND", "salary_period": "month", "vacancies": 100, "vacancies_text": "100 postes ouverts", "experience": "1 à 3 ans", "education_level": "Maîtrise, IEP, IUP, Bac + 4", "languages": [ "Français" ], "snippet": "Rejoignez l'Équipe Dynamique d'IKI Assurances ! Nouveau Challenge, Nouveau Vous ! IKI Assurances, groupe Filiassur, est à la recherche de Conseillers Commerc...", "posted_text": "Il'y a 4 semaines", "date_posted": "2026-10-13", "posted_at": "2026-10-13T19:32:09+01:00", "valid_through": "2026-11-11T19:32:09+01:00", "expires_text": "11/11/2026", "featured": true, "is_new": true, "badges": [ "Featured", "New" ], "direct_apply": true, "requirements_html": "

Profil Recherché :
- Excellente maîtrise de la langue française- Première expérience en télévente exigée

\n

Compétences R...", "requirements_text": "Profil Recherché :\n- Excellente maîtrise de la langue française- Première expérience en télévente exigée\n\nCompétences Requises:\n- Aisance téléphonique et fac...", "description_html": "

Rejoignez l'Équipe Dynamique d'IKI Assurances !

\n

Nouveau Challenge, Nouveau Vous !

\n

IKI Assurances, groupe Filiassur, est à la recherc...", "description_text": "Rejoignez l'Équipe Dynamique d'IKI Assurances !\n\nNouveau Challenge, Nouveau Vous !\n\nIKI Assurances, groupe Filiassur, est à la recherche de Conseillers Comme...", "keywords": [ "IKI Assurances Groupe Filiasur", "call center", "assurances", "centre d'appel", "mutuelles", "vente", "Commercial Mutuelle Santé", "commerce", "gestion", "Centres d'appels", "emploi Ariana" ], "job_url": "https://www.tanitjobs.com/job/2015538/commercial-mutuelle-santé-h-f-ariana/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "fixture", "source": "tanitjobs.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Numeric id of the job: the number in the job address (/job///). It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the job. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company as shown on the job. | | `company_id` | string, null | Number of the company page on Tanitjobs. Needs the job page. | | `company_url` | string, null | Company page on Tanitjobs. Needs the job page. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL. The list shows a logo only on some jobs, the job page carries it when the company has one. | | `company_website` | string, null | Website of the hiring company when the job page gives one. Needs the job page. | | `company_verified` | boolean, null | true when the job page shows the 'verified by Tanitjobs.com' badge for the company. Needs the job page. | | `location` | string, null | Place of the job as shown on the list, for example Tunis, Tunis, Tunisie (area, governorate, country) or Télétravail. | | `city` | string, null | First part of a location with three parts (area or city). From the job page address when details are on. | | `region` | string, null | Governorate (second part of the location). From the job page address when details are on. | | `postal_code` | string, null | Postal code of the job address. Needs the job page. | | `country` | string, null | Country (last part of the location). From the job page address when details are on. | | `contract_type` | string, null | Contract tag of the list: CDI, CDD, SIVP, Temps plein, Freelance / Indépendant and similar. | | `contract_types` | array | Contract types wanted, from the job page (the 'Type d'emploi désiré' line). Needs the job page. | | `employment_types` | array | Employment types of the job posting data (FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, INTERN ...). Needs the job page. | | `sector` | string, null | Business sector (occupational category) of the job posting, in French. Needs the job page. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary line of the job page ('Rémunération proposée'), as written. Needs the job page. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower salary bound from the job posting data. Needs the job page and only when the employer states a salary. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper salary bound from the job posting data. Needs the job page and only when the employer states a salary. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | Currency code of the salary, for example TND. | | `salary_period` | string, null | month, year, week, day or hour. | | `vacancies` | integer, null | Number of open positions of the job page. Needs the job page. | | `vacancies_text` | string, null | Open positions as written on the job page, for example 100 postes ouverts. Needs the job page. | | `experience` | string, null | Experience wanted, as written ('Experience'), for example 1 à 3 ans. Needs the job page. | | `education_level` | string, null | Education level wanted ('Niveau d'étude'), as written. Needs the job page. | | `languages` | array | Languages wanted, from the job page. Needs the job page. | | `snippet` | string, null | First lines of the job text as shown on the list (ends with ... when cut). | | `posted_text` | string, null | Date text of the list (dd/mm/yyyy). null on featured jobs, which show no date. With details on and no list date, the age text of the job page, for example Il'y a 4 semaines. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). From the job posting data when details are on, otherwise from the list date. null when neither is shown. | | `posted_at` | string, null | Posting time with offset (ISO 8601) from the job posting data. Needs the job page. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Last day the job is valid, ISO 8601, from the job posting data. Needs the job page. | | `expires_text` | string, null | Expiry date as written on the job page (dd/mm/yyyy). Needs the job page. | | `featured` | boolean | true for jobs in the featured block at the top of the list. | | `is_new` | boolean | true when the list marks the job as new. | | `badges` | array | Badges of the job in English: Featured, New. | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | true when the job posting data says candidates can apply directly on the site. Needs the job page. | | `requirements_html` | string, null | Requirements section ('Exigences de l'emploi') as HTML. Needs the job page. | | `requirements_text` | string, null | Requirements section as plain text. Needs the job page. | | `description_html` | string, null | Job description as HTML, in French as published. Needs the job page. | | `description_text` | string, null | Job description as plain text. Needs the job page. | | `keywords` | array | Keyword tags of the job page ('Mots clés'). Needs the job page. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job on Tanitjobs, as linked on the list. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | true when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | Keyword that found the job, or 'all jobs' when no keyword is set. | | `source` | string | Site the job comes from (tanitjobs.com). | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was scraped (ISO 8601, UTC). | Fields that a job does not show are `null`. Fields marked as coming from the job page are `null` (or an empty list) when `includeDetails` is off. The list shows no date on featured jobs; with details on the date comes from the job page. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0012 per job result ($1.20 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [Bayt Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/bayt-scraper): Jobs from Bayt, the job board for the Middle East and North Africa. - [Jobrapido Scraper - Multi-Country Job Aggregator](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobrapido-scraper): Jobs from the Jobrapido aggregator in many countries. - [HelloWork FR Scraper: French Job Listings](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/hellowork-fr-scraper): French-language job listings from HelloWork. - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. ## FAQ **How does the location filter work?** The site's own location search needs an address lookup, so the actor reads the location text of each job (for example "Sousse, Sousse, Tunisie") and keeps the jobs that mention one of your places. A place that matches nothing returns no jobs. With a narrow place and a broad search the actor reads more result pages to find matches, up to 60 pages per search. **Why do some jobs have no posting date?** Featured jobs at the top of a result page show no date on the list. Turn on `includeDetails` to get the exact date and time from the job page. **Why is the salary empty for most jobs?** Most employers do not state a salary. When they do, `salary_text`, `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_currency` and `salary_period` are filled (job page needed). **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. Jobs the site suggests on a page without matches are not returned. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/tanitjobs-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
